faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the National AYUSH Mission, Thrissur District, Kerala, to fill up required healthcare positions on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Ayurveda Therapist (Male)?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Ayurveda Therapist (Male) post under this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the offline application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the filled application form via post or directly to the designated office address is 12-10-2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed the Ayurveda Therapist Course (DAME) conducted by the Government of Kerala for a duration of one year or a one-year Ayurveda Therapist Course from NARIP.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is set at 50 years. Please refer to the official notification for any applicable age relaxations.

faq.question: Q6. What is the monthly salary for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Ayurveda Therapist (Male) position will receive a monthly consolidated salary of 14,700/-.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection procedure for this job?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a written test (conducted if there are 20 or more applicants) followed by an interview session.

faq.question: Q8. When is the walk-in or interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The interview for the shortlisted candidates who apply within the stipulated timeline is scheduled to take place on 17-10-2026.

faq.question: Q9. What is the mode of application submission?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly offline. Candidates must fill out the form and submit it either directly or through post in a sealed envelope.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the completed application form be sent?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent to The District Programme Manager, DPMSU, National AYUSH Mission, Rama Varma District Ayurveda Hospital Campus, Palace Road, Patturaikkal, Thrissur, on working days.
